original.target_description: Experiment 5: four listeners judged whether a single tone was higher or lower than the nearest component of a preceding chord. Detectability d 0 was analysed over chord tone count N and interstimulus interval (ISI). Study and outcome located, but the supplied p. 5 locator and general description do not identify which ANOVA effect is the target test.

n.sample_role: Experiment 5 listeners; participant-level repeated-measures sample. ISI F(3, 9) and interaction F(9, 27) corroborate four listeners. The 480 trials per listener per condition are repeated observations.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for Experiment 5. Two listeners were authors L.D. and M.S.; each listener initially trained for at least 4 hr.
n.location: Published p. 89 (PDF page 5), Experiments 4 and 5, Method—Participants; Results.
n.quote:
Experiment 5 was performed with 4
listeners, also including 2 of the authors (L.D. and M.S.).

notes: Original-only blind validation. Published article title and all four authors verified on rendered PDF page 1; participant count, sample meaning, and candidate test numbers verified on rendered PDF page 5 (published p. 89). Source PDF: /home/lukas/work/fred-mac-recovery-20261030/continuation-1201/private_batch_01/artifacts/1308e6220b5b0ede0c999c8b_ebsco.pdf. No manuscript or appendix substitution. The supplied study identifier locates Experiment 5, but the locator does not distinguish the ISI main effect from the N-by-ISI interaction. Consequently target_match is null, and effect size and p are left null rather than assigning an unspecified test. Alternative printed tests: ISI main effect F(3, 9) = 8.5, p = .005, eta-squared = .74; interaction F(9, 27) = 2.6, p = .03, eta-squared = .46. N main effect is reported only as F(3, 9) < 1. These are separate tests. Canonical text renders printed eta-squared as Z2, equals signs as 5, and delta as D; numeric meanings checked on rendered PDF. The n quote preserves exact canonical-text wording and line break. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders.
